position.quote: While some advocate building more roads to ease congestion, I largely agree that public transport deserves the greater share of investment
position.comment: 立场明确且为“有限同意”，后文第四段的让步与第五段的结论都在这一框架内，读完全文态度清晰一致。

paragraphs.main_point: While some advocate building more roads to ease congestion, I largely agree that public transport deserves the greater share of investment, because it addresses the causes of traffic problems rather than merely their symptoms.
paragraphs.comment: 引入话题并给出带理由的立场句，为下文两条主体论证与让步定下框架。

paragraphs.main_point: The strongest argument for prioritising public transport is efficiency.
paragraphs.comment: 用运力对比与“新路诱增车流”的因果机制论证效率优势，理由充分，直接支撑立场。

paragraphs.main_point: Public transport also brings wider social and environmental benefits.
paragraphs.comment: 从公平出行与环境两个角度延伸论点，并用thereby说明对就业与服务获取的影响，属于有效支撑。

paragraphs.main_point: Nevertheless, it would be unrealistic to stop road building altogether.
paragraphs.comment: 让步段说明例外情形（人口稀疏地区、货运），为“有限同意”划定边界，并未削弱自身立场，无需反驳。

paragraphs.main_point: In conclusion, although some road investment is still justified, governments should concentrate their spending on public transport
paragraphs.comment: 结论重申主立场并保留让步，与首段完全一致。

improvements.quote: It gives affordable mobility to those who cannot drive, such as students, the elderly and lower-income workers
improvements.suggestion: 此处可补一句假设性说明，例如设想一位住在郊区、依靠公交去上班的工人因此获得更多就业选择，使论证从概括走向具体。

improvements.quote: In sparsely populated regions, buses and trains are rarely viable, and freight still relies heavily on trucks.
improvements.suggestion: 可在此句后加一句限定，说明这类道路投入应“按需、精准”而非大规模新建，使让步与本段结尾的targeted呼应得更紧。
